title: Donetick
name: donetick
description: Chore and task tracker for households, with natural-language scheduling, assignee rotation, subtasks, points and rewards, labels, NFC tags and a calendar feed. Source: https://github.com/donetick/donetick

env.name: DT_SQLITE_PATH
env.label: Database file
env.description: Keeps the database in the data volume, so leave it as it is.

env.name: DT_SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST
env.label: Address
env.description: Where you'll open it, like http://192.168.1.10:2021. The calendar feed link is built from this.

note: Open http://<your-host>:2021 and click Create one. Sign-ups stay open: everyone makes their own account, then asks to join your circle with the code under Settings --> Circle Settings, where you accept them. Once everyone's in, add DONETICK_DISABLE_SIGNUP=true to the container's environment. Crash reports and usage analytics stay off unless you tick them on the screen after signing up. Photo attachments and avatars need S3-compatible storage set up as their storage docs say, and uploads fail without it. The phone apps only connect over HTTPS with a real certificate, so they need a proxy in front. The SQLite database lives in the data volume, and the generated login secret and settings (selfhosted.yaml) in the config one. Docs: docs.donetick.com
